events.title: Deck Forge Is in Steam Next Fest — Play the Free Demo, Solo or Co-op
events.summary: Deck Forge is in Steam Next Fest! From October 19 to 26 the free demo is front and centre, and it has just had its biggest month of work yet. If you've tried it before, it's worth another run. If you haven't: it's free, it's long, and you can play it with friends. events.title: The Daily Forge is Lit — One Seed, One Class, One Ladder
events.summary: The Daily Forge is lit. Every day at midnight UTC, the Forge deals the whole community one hand: the same seed, the same map, the same class. No lucky maps, no dodging elites your rival had to fight. Whoever forges the sharpest deck from identical parts tops the board. 🔥 How it works One seed for everyone — the daily run is identical for every player: same route options, same shops, same boss waiting at the end. events.title: Deck Forge Now Has Online Co-op — And It's In The Free Demo
events.summary: The forge runs co-op. The biggest update in Deck Forge's history is live — and every bit of it is in the free demo, right now. ⚔ Real online co-op, zero friction Quick Match — one click finds you a party. No friend codes, no Discord links, no lobbies to babysit. Runs launch the moment two forgers meet, and grow up to four. Drop-in, drop-out — join a run already in progress at the next map node. A quick six-pick draft forges your deck, and you're fighting within the minute. Play it your way — sol
